Here's a summary of the three root bugs that were fixed:

**Bug 1 — "UNVERIFIED QR" on your own generated QRs** (`useQrDetail.ts`)
The verdict logic checked `isBranded` but never checked whether the viewer *is the owner*. Now `isQrOwner === true` is part of the verified check, and owners see **"YOUR QR"** instead of "UNVERIFIED QR".

**Bug 2 — Wrong template type used for parsing/rendering** (`ContentCard.tsx`)
`ContentCard` was selecting its parser (wifi, contact, sms, reviewpage, etc.) and field extractor purely from `contentType`. If `contentType` was `"url"` but `templateKey` was `"reviewpage"` or `"wifi"`, the card fell back to a generic text box. Now it derives an `effectiveType = templateKey ?? contentType`, so all 35 generator templates render their correct icon, label, and structured info fields.

**Bug 3 — Content type detection ignored `templateKey`** (`qr-display-utils.ts`)
`getDetailContentType` only checked stored `contentType` and then ran content-sniffing heuristics. It never looked at `templateKey`. Now `templateKey` is used as a trusted second-priority source — before the heuristics run — so the My QR screen and any other caller also gets the right type.
